result.paraphrase: MSI Radeon RX 5700 XT MECH OC with 8GB GDDR6. Radeon RX 5700 XT MECH OC features core and memory boost clocks of up to 1925 MHz, game clock 1815 MHz, and base clock 1670 MHz, with 14Gbps memory speed and 8GB GDDR6. Includes 3 DisplayPort outputs and 1 HDMI output, TORX Fan 3.0, Afterburner Overclocking Utility, Kombustor benchmark support for the latest DirectX versions, Predator in-game video recording, and AMD Radeon FreeSync for smooth gaming. Graphics card with 2560 cores, NAVI 10 XT core name, 256-bit memory bus, PCI Express 4.0 interface, OpenGL 4.5, DirectX 12 support, HDCP 2.2, maximum digital resolution of 7680x4320, 4 display support, 225 W power consumption, recommended 750 W PSU, Crossfire 2-way bridgeless multi-GPU, 232 x 126 x 46 mm dimensions, VR Ready, and 8-pin plus 6-pin power connectors. 3-year warranty.
